demo.label: DEMO
demo.banner: this page uses representative mock results so you can evaluate the workflow immediately.
demo.hero_title: See exactly what Tender Engine would extract from a tender PDF.
demo.hero_description: Choose a representative sample or upload a PDF name into demo mode. The page simulates the pipeline, then reveals BOQ lines, pricing, warnings, confidence scores, and review signals without requiring an account.
demo.what_demo_proves_desc: The useful part is not pretending every PDF is perfect. It is showing where extraction is strong, where the engine is cautious, and what a reviewer should check next.
demo.sample_subtitle: Each sample is mapped to a pre-generated result profile.
demo.upload_description: Demo upload accepts a local PDF, then runs the same simulated pipeline using a representative mock result. Your file is not sent to the backend from this public page.
demo.limit_1: Shows the real product flow and review surfaces.
demo.limit_2: Uses pre-generated BOQ, pricing, and confidence data.
demo.limit_3: Does not process private tender contents until a user signs in.
demo.simulating_desc: Processing {label}. This is a client-side demo animation connected to pre-generated results.
demo.uploaded_demo_desc: Uploaded-file demo: the filename is yours, while the displayed extraction is representative sample data
demo.signed_in_accounts: Signed-in accounts can export and process private PDFs.
demo.executive_summary_desc: A concise, review-ready interpretation of the extracted tender.
demo.confidence_scores_desc: Every stage carries its own confidence. Low scores are visible by design.
demo.boq_description: {count} extracted line items with quantities, rates, and amounts.
demo.no_warnings_desc: All simulated stages completed and passed the confidence thresholds for this sample.
demo.review_signals_desc: Tender Engine should be useful even when it is cautious. These flags stay visible for human review.
demo.cta_title: Process private tenders with the full product.
demo.cta_description: Sign in to upload real tender PDFs, persist results, export BOQ workbooks, and compare tenders over time.
demo.honesty_point_1: Demo results are pre-generated for speed.
demo.honesty_point_2: Uploaded PDFs are not sent to the backend on this page.
demo.honesty_point_3: Warnings, failed stages, and confidence scores stay visible.
demo.best_first_step_desc: Visitors can see value immediately by processing a sample tender, then sign up when they are ready to run private documents.
demo.schedule_phases_not_extracted: Schedule phases were not extracted for this sample.

landing.hero_subtitle: Extract, analyse, and review tender documents with transparent processing. See confidence scores, warnings, and extraction results — all in one dashboard.
landing.product_preview_title: Clear extraction results your team can actually review.
landing.product_preview_desc: Tender Engine is designed to show useful automation and its limits in the same view.
landing.executive_dashboard_desc: View a confidence-scored breakdown of every tender extraction. Completed stages, warnings, and failed items stay visible.
landing.detailed_boq_pricing_desc: Review extracted BOQ items with rates, amounts, pricing additions, and the evidence needed for estimator review.
landing.for_procurement_title: Publish clearer tenders before suppliers ever see them.
landing.for_procurement_desc: Procurement teams can use Tender Engine to review draft tender packs, spot ambiguous BOQ items, and reduce clarification cycles before publication.
landing.value_procurement_1: Tender Health Reports for draft documents
landing.value_procurement_2: Flags for unclear specifications, missing quantities, and risk areas
landing.value_procurement_3: Visible confidence scoring for governance and review
landing.pricing_title: Free during early beta, with guided pilots available.
landing.pricing_desc: Start with the public demo, create an account for live processing, or contact us for a structured team pilot.
landing.early_beta_desc: For contractors and procurement teams evaluating Tender Engine during beta.
landing.pilot_teams_desc: For companies and public offices that want a guided tender-processing pilot.
landing.trust_title: Honesty Architecture is the product philosophy.
landing.trust_desc: Tender Engine should help you move faster without encouraging blind trust. That is why uncertainty, warnings, failed stages, and confidence scores are treated as first-class output.
landing.trust_card_1_desc: Every major extraction stage reports reliability in plain view.
landing.trust_card_2_desc: Useful results can still be shown when one stage needs review.
landing.trust_card_3_desc: Warnings point people toward the parts that deserve attention.
landing.built_for: Built for the teams that build Africa.
landing.built_for_desc: Tender Engine is designed in collaboration with contractors, estimators, and procurement professionals who work with South African tenders every day.
landing.testimonial_quote: The transparency is what sold us. We can see exactly where to trust the output and where to double-check — that's the kind of tool you can actually use on real bids.
landing.cta_title: Ready to see Tender Engine in action?
landing.cta_desc: Try the live demo or create a free account to process your own tender documents.

procurement.hero_desc: Upload your draft tender. Our processing engine analyzes it and flags ambiguous BOQ items, unclear specifications, missing information, and risky clauses — with clear confidence scores. Receive a professional Tender Health Report before publishing.
procurement.how_it_works_desc: From draft to published — add a quality check before your tender goes to market.
procurement.step_1_desc: Submit your tender document (PDF, DOCX, or TXT) through our secure portal.
procurement.step_2_desc: Our engine extracts and analyzes every section — BOQ items, specifications, pricing, schedules, and workforce requirements.
procurement.step_3_desc: Get a clear report showing confidence scores, flagging ambiguous or missing items, and highlighting potential risks — before you publish.
procurement.why_ai_desc: Better tender documents lead to better procurement outcomes for everyone.
procurement.benefit_1_desc: Flag ambiguous BOQ items, unclear specifications, and contradictory clauses before they reach suppliers. Clearer tenders attract better, more competitive bids.
procurement.benefit_2_desc: When tender documents are clear and well-structured, more qualified bidders can respond confidently — increasing competition and driving better value for money.
procurement.benefit_3_desc: Catch pricing gaps, missing quantities, and risky clauses before publication. Fewer ambiguities mean fewer contractor claims and cost overruns during project execution.
procurement.benefit_4_desc: Reduce the back-and-forth of tender clarification questions, cut evaluation cycles, and lower the administrative burden on your procurement team.
procurement.benefit_5_desc: Every tender health report includes clear confidence scores. You can demonstrate due diligence, show exactly where improvements were made, and build trust with bidders and oversight bodies.
procurement.built_for_desc: Our tender analysis is designed to support procurement professionals across the public sector.
procurement.audience_1_desc: Support SCM directives by ensuring tender documents are clear, complete, and compliant before publication.
procurement.audience_2_desc: Streamline tender review processes, reduce clarification cycles, and publish higher-quality bid documents faster.
procurement.audience_3_desc: Eskom, Transnet, PRASA, and others — reduce contract disputes by catching risks early, before tenders go to market.
procurement.pilot_desc: We are currently offering free pilot programs to selected government departments and SOEs. Get a Tender Health Report for up to 3 draft tenders at no cost.
procurement.pilot_no_cc: No credit card required. Strict confidentiality guaranteed.

dashboard.title: Tender Engine
dashboard.subtitle: Processing Dashboard
dashboard.select_job: Select a job from the history to view its result.
dashboard.empty_description: Upload a tender document to get started. Once processed, you'll see extracted data including sector, duration, locations, BOQ items, and pricing.
dashboard.cold_start_warning: This app runs on free Render infrastructure. The first request each session may take ~30s for the backend to wake up — after that, processing runs at normal speed.
dashboard.about_tool_desc: I've built this to be a partner to the human expert. It does the hard work, but you're still the one in the driver's seat. Always review extracted data carefully before using it in production decisions.

result.title: Processing Result
result.completed: Processing completed successfully — all stages finished.
result.partial_success: Partial Success — some stages completed, others failed.
result.partial_success_desc: Successfully extracted data is shown below. Unavailable sections are marked with failure reasons.
result.pricing_stage_failed: The pricing calculation stage failed during processing.
result.high_risk_summary: High risk detected: Significant manual verification of pricing required.
result.medium_risk_summary: Medium risk detected: Some manual verification recommended.
result.low_risk_summary: Low risk detected: Extraction completed with high confidence.
result.required_field_missing: Required field missing: please update project details
